description:
Weighted results for one Male Confidence Index 2025 question, optionally split by a demographic.

    Returns weighted percentages (single choice and multi-select) or weighted means (numeric), with the
    unweighted n for each cell. Cells under 30 respondents return suppressed: true.

by.description: Optional demographic to split results by: "age_group", "state", "income", "gender", "employment", or any single-choice question id. Omit for the overall result only.
by.title: By

filter.description: Optional {variable: value} map restricting the base, e.g. {"age_group": "18-28"} or {"S2_age": "30-39"}. Use "a|b" in a value to match several.
filter.title: Filter

gender.description: Optional base: "men", "women" or "all". Default: whoever was asked the question.
gender.title: Gender

question_id.description: Survey question id from mci_questions, e.g. "Q15", "Q11" (a multi-select group), "F9", "D9". Q* = asked of men, F* = women, S*/D* = everyone.
question_id.title: Question Id

name: mci_results
title: Male Confidence Index: results
